docs.purpose: Powers the address and permit-number search box in the Flight Center watchlist tool, letting an admin find a specific permit or committee-of-adjustment application to add to their saved list.
docs.data_story: It reads 2 tables — `permits` and `coa_applications` and writes nothing. Its response shape is **unmeasured** as a pick-by-name whitelist — it passes rows through, spreads a row into a computed object, or assembles the payload dynamically, so there is no single list naming what leaves the server. It is called from 1 place: `src/features/admin-flight-center/api/useWatchlistSearch.ts`.
docs.under_126: Becomes a **CONTRACT descriptor** of archetype `QUERY`. It declares its `database.reads[]` with named columns, its response projection as an explicit whitelist, its auth class, its rate bucket and its staleness — and `outputs.writes` is forced to `"none"`. Its `consumers[]` becomes the edge list of the fan-out graph — the join nothing in this estate holds today.

notes: Response items are `{...row, lead_key}` — a raw-row spread plus one computed field. Ports the substring-ILIKE logic from the consumer-facing /api/leads/search route but sits behind its own verifyAdminAuth rather than inheriting consumer auth. | MEASURED 2026-09-15: Census checklist: both named tables (permits, coa_applications) VERIFIED. Census MISSED `profiles` (verifyAdminAuth, src/lib/auth/verify-admin.ts:117-120). FINDINGS: (1) The ILIKE pattern is built by template interpolation `%${q}%` at :95 but bound as $1 at :99 — parameterised, NOT injectable; however q's own LIKE metacharacters are NOT escaped, so a user typing '%' or '_' gets wildcard semantics (a usability quirk, and each arm's LIMIT 20 bounds the cost). (2) The operator's raw query string q is written to the application log at :123 and to the error context at :140; the comment at :120 justifies this as non-PII — that is a claim in a comment, and the code logs q unconditionally. (3) The `as string` casts at :108-115 rely on SQL-shape invariants documented in comments (:107, :114) rather than runtime checks; the downstream Zod parse at :136 would throw (→500) rather than 400 if the invariant broke. (4) The header comment at :13-15 asserts pg_trgm GIN indexes from mig 215 accelerate the query — an unverified claim from this file's perspective; no index hint appears in the SQL. (5) No SELECT * anywhere; both arms enumerate columns (:41-46, :56-62). | Caching: none observed — no Cache-Control, no dynamic/revalidate, no in-process memo in route.ts:1-143 | Pagination: No offset/cursor. Each UNION arm is hard-capped at LIMIT 20 (src/app/api/admin/leads/watchlist/search/route.ts:52 and :67) so the response is at most 40 rows; there is no `meta` total and ok() is called with no meta argument (:136 → meta null per src/features/leads/api/envelope.ts:49). | Other guards / classification: No CSRF check (GET is not a mutating method, src/lib/auth/verify-admin.ts:45,70). MFA gate inert unless ADMIN_MFA_ENFORCED=true (src/lib/auth/verify-admin.ts:143). | Locking tests: src/tests/admin-watchlist.infra.test.ts.
